findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

A can of sauce was observed with major dents in the side and in the seams. The PIC was shown and moved the can to discard to correct.  Ensure that all damaged cans are separated for credit/discard in the facility.
